# Token-Efficient Angular

Inspect only:

route/component -> template/style when relevant -> direct service -> referenced model/shared component when needed.

Reuse existing UI patterns and shared components. Preserve accessibility and responsive behavior. Avoid unrelated refactoring. Run targeted type/build/tests first.
